# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities privately using [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/jarymor-ux/kee-route-manager/security/advisories/new). Do not attach live subscriptions, credentials, UUIDs, router backups or diagnostic archives to public issues.

Only the newest RC receives fixes during release preparation. RC2 is experimental pending hardware acceptance. Automatic update application is deliberately disabled. See [security boundaries](../docs/SECURITY.md) and [known limitations](../docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
